rule: ไก่ is one bird and one slang chain. Sense 1, the fowl, takes everything the bird itself motivates — the breeds and their wild kin, the meat and the dishes, the body parts, and every figure drawn from a chicken's anatomy or habits: the uvula, the pen nib, the ๏ sign, daybreak, scrawled handwriting, cheating at sport. Plant and bird names built on the bird file there too; ไก่ has no ใช้ประกอบชื่อ sense and the literal one is where หมีคน and กะตังใบ went. Senses 2-4 are a graded chain about a woman and take only a word that NAMES such a woman: ไก่หลง is the lured one, sense 3. Sense 5, the weak or unskilled person, takes ไก่อ่อน.

notes.h2: 2026-09-04 — heads 105-107, and a class of pointer entries filed as if they were compounds
notes.h3: ไก่ — twenty of twenty-two are the bird, and the RID says why
notes.text:
ไก่'s five senses look like a wide head and are not. Sense 1 is the fowl; senses
2, 3 and 4 are a graded slang chain about a woman (selling, lured, dressed to
invite); sense 5 is the modern gaming *อ่อนด้อย*, against ตัวตึง. Twenty
compounds file at 1 and only two leave it.

notes.h2: 2026-09-04 — heads 105-107, and a class of pointer entries filed as if they were compounds
notes.h3: ไก่ — twenty of twenty-two are the bird, and the RID says why
notes.text:
The rule: **sense 1 takes everything the bird itself motivates** — the breeds and
their wild kin, the meat and the dishes, the body parts, and every figure drawn
from a chicken's anatomy or habits. That last clause is what does the work, and
it is a large group: ลิ้นไก่ the uvula, ปากไก่ the pen nib, ตาไก่ the ๏ sign,
ไก่โห่ daybreak, ไก่เขี่ย scrawled handwriting, ลักไก่ to cheat at sport. None of
these is about a chicken and all of them are built on one.

notes.h2: 2026-09-04 — heads 105-107, and a class of pointer entries filed as if they were compounds
notes.h3: ไก่ — twenty of twenty-two are the bird, and the RID says why
notes.text:
Only **ไก่หลง** reaches the woman senses. Its RID gloss — *ผู้หญิงที่รู้ไม่เท่าทันโลก
พลัดมาอยู่ในที่ที่ถูกผู้ชายล่อลวงไปได้* — is sense 3's own gloss (*ผู้หญิงที่ถูกล่อลวงมา*)
with the straying added. Filed at 3, the sense whose *via* explains it. **ไก่อ่อน**
is the greenhorn and files at 5.

notes.h2: 2026-09-04 — heads 105-107, and a class of pointer entries filed as if they were compounds
notes.h3: ไก่ — twenty of twenty-two are the bird, and the RID says why
notes.text:
**ไก่กา carries its own date.** Its gloss is *ไม่จริงใจ, โกหก, หลอกลวง*, which is
not the received "a nobody" reading of ไก่กา at all. The etymology says why:
`ไก่ + กา; มาจากรายการเกมโชว์ "จริงใจหรือไก่กา"` — the sense comes from a game
show. Both parts are literal birds, so it files at 1, and the note is the point:
a compound whose meaning was set by a broadcast, not by the morpheme.

notes.h2: 2026-09-04 — heads 105-107, and a class of pointer entries filed as if they were compounds
notes.h3: ไก่ — twenty of twenty-two are the bird, and the RID says why
notes.text:
**ไก่ฟ้า, ไก่เตี้ย and ไก่ไห้ are name-use with nowhere to go.** The pipeline tags
them `biological` and prints *"this head has no name-use sense to file it under —
add one, then this files itself."* I did not add one. Sense 1's own gloss says
*สัตว์ปีกจำพวกนก มีหลายวงศ์* — birds of SEVERAL families — so the pheasant is
already inside it; and the two plants (a beach vine, a thorny shrub) are named
for the bird, which is where หมีคน went at คน 1 and กะตังใบ at ใบ 1. Filed at 1
on that precedent. **If a ใช้ประกอบชื่อ sense is ever added to ไก่, these three
are the words to move.**
